title: Unit – 2 : Session – 12 : SLO – 2 | Using Packages
sections: Snippet A: prints a random integer between 0 and 9 (inclusive) — e.g., 7; the exact value varies per run because rand.nextInt(10) is random.
Snippet B: prints 25 — c.square(5) computes 5 × 5 from the user-defined mymath.Calculator class.
Snippet C: prints the current date in ISO format (yyyy-MM-dd) — e.g., 2025-09-21, whatever LocalDate.now() returns on the day it runs.
